name: What is the typical cost range for building a high-quality outdoor bar?
description: Costs for a high-quality outdoor bar typically range from $15,000 for basic models to $40,000-$70,000+ for elaborate designs.

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for building a high-quality outdoor bar?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a high-quality outdoor bar can range broadly, typically starting from $15,000 for a basic, well-appointed setup. More elaborate designs incorporating premium materials like custom stonework, integrated refrigeration, sinks, ice makers, and extensive lighting can easily reach $40,000 to $70,000 or more. Factors influencing cost include size, choice of appliances, countertop materials, plumbing and electrical requirements, and custom features.
